4.label: Exceeds Standard
4.description: Multiplies and divides within 100 fluently; models unit fractions and justifies fraction models on number lines.
4.action: Accelerate to Grade 4 fraction equivalence & decomposing

3.label: Meets Standard
3.description: Fluently multiplies and divides within 100 and understands unit fractions 1/b.

2.label: Approaching Standard
2.description: Multiplies using skip counting; needs visual support for division or fractions.
2.action: Targeted multiplication arrays and visual fraction models

1.label: Below Standard
1.description: Struggles with concept of equal groups and division.
1.action: Intensive repeated addition and grouping intervention

standards.description: Interpret products of whole numbers, e.g., interpret 5 × 7 as the total number of objects in 5 groups of 7 objects each.

levels.4: Applies properties of operations (distributive/associative) to solve multi-step problems.
levels.3: Accurately represents and computes products within 100.
levels.2: Solves using repeated addition with minor counting errors.

standards.description: Understand a fraction 1/b as the quantity formed by 1 part when a whole is partitioned into b equal parts.

levels.4: Explains partitioning and locates unit and non-unit fractions on a number line.
levels.3: Correctly identifies unit fractions 1/b in area and set models.
levels.2: Identifies shaded parts but confuses numerator and denominator.
levels.1: Unable to partition shapes into equal parts.
